programmes.d: A gang steals a gigantic bar of gold and commandeers the Dodge City blacksmith shop in order to divide the loot.
A hanging-minded jury sits in judgment of Lijah, a stern, silent mountain man accused of three wanton slayings.
Kitty helps Marshal Matt Dillon switch identities with a killer in order to escape when they are kidnapped by outlaws.
Matt, Doc, Festus, and several other passengers are trapped on a train by a band of Indians in the snowy Colorado mountains.
Marshal Dillon is cornered by three Sioux Indians as he goes to find help for the freezing passengers of a trapped train.

Dillon finds himself in the revengeful hands of a half-crazed widower who plans, with the aid of his four surviving sons, to hunt Dillon down and kill him to revenge the death of his son, a wanted murderer.
Chester takes care of Doc when they are ambushed by a pair of outlaws.
A drover asks Matt and Chester to help him protect his boss' herd from a renegade raid.
With Matt out of town, Doc only has Chester to protect him when his life is threatened.
An immigrant farmer is branded as a coward when the facts behind his slaying of a notorious outlaw become known.
A former gunslinger is being bothered by bullies.
Kitty becomes responsible for a wanted murderer and, believing him innocent, refuses to turn him over to an out-of-town sheriff.
Two trail bosses argue over how to get across a swollen river.
Even though Doc has confessed to murdering the man that shot his horse, Matt is unwilling to arrest him.
Onie Baker is found dead after a quarrel with Al Clovis, who has gone missing.
Allen Garfield guest stars as a school teacher in an episode of Gunsmoke that makes a strong statement for compulsory education for children, even in the less enlightened Dodge City of the 1870’s.
Two recaptured Army deserters frame Festus Haggen in an attempted murder of their sergeant.
Matt and Chester track down a horse thief.
Newly takes a bride.
When a renegade Indian kills Matt's friend, the Marshal pursues the killer high into the New Mexico mountains.

The brother of a man Matt was forced to kill vows to kill Matt by any means necessary.
A young outlaw is reformed by the kindness and help of an elderly female junk collector.
In part two, A young outlaw is reformed by the kindness and help of an elderly female junk collector.

While pursuing an old foe, Matt Dillon is ambushed by mountaineers, then saved by a muleskinner and Miss Kitty, and after another of Dillon's arch-enemies is released from prison, settles an old score with his desperate foe on the streets of Dodge City.
A businessman arouses suspicion when he seems to have more than a business interest in the gold shipments of a stagecoach line.
Matt tracks a murderer to a strange town where the people are unwilling to cooperate.
Matt is forced to arrest his childhood hero, who is now the leader of a gang of horse thieves.
Matt suspects Kitty's new saloon girl is a hired killer.
Matt protects a suspected killer from a trigger-happy deputy.
On a hunting trip, Matt, Doc and Chester find a savagely beaten Indian boy.
